sources.snippet: This repository contains the low-rank adaptation (LoRA) checkpoint for generating high-fidelity Vietnamese calligraphy characters and phrases. It is fine-tuned on top of Ideogram4 (9.3B) using multi-word compound datasets, with the goal of accurate rendering for Vietnamese diacritics and brush styles.
